Sansan House, Thao Dien
Sep 2026 • Couples
Accidentally stopped by Sansan House in Thao Dien and found the whole BBQ chicken quite interesting. Whole roasted chicken, crispy skin, tender meat inside, served with 4 kinds of sauces. My favorite part is the pasta underneath, because it soaks up all the chicken sauce, so it's quite addictive 😂

The restaurant not only has chicken but also pizza, Korean side dishes, and craft beer. The portion looks quite large, it would be more reasonable for 2-4 people to order it and share.

The space is also large, with indoor, outdoor, and private rooms. The evening lights are quite beautiful, suitable for going out with friends or for a date.

Discover Sansan House: Super delicious whole BBQ chicken
Sep 2026 • Friends
Catching a super delicious dining spot for the weekend — Sansan House!
The menu here is super rich, but the "spotlight" must be the Cheongyang Basil BBQ Chicken. Whole roasted chicken, juicy meat, mixed with pasta, mushrooms, tokbokki, potatoes, and the characteristic fiery heat of Cheongyang chili peppers from Korea — one bite and you're hooked.
To prevent feeling full, you can order a fresh Salad Burrata Cheese and a Pizza Potato Bacon Crush overflowing with toppings. The plus point is that every dish is super big, this set is enough for 4-5 people to finish (our group of 3 had to sadly take it home).
The drink is good, highly recommend having a glass of beer with chicken, it's amazing. 10 points for the quick and friendly employee. Will definitely come back!
